candidates.summary: The allow_zero_fee_txs=false CheckTx refusal, the shipped validator default, has no test at any level: every sponsorship test and the integration harness set AllowZeroFeeTxs true
candidates.failure_scenario: Replace `if !app.allowZeroFeeTxs {` at baseapp.go:661 with `if false {`. A validator left on the default allow_zero_fee_txs=false, on a chain whose governance opened MaxGasCreditPerTx, then admits every 0-fee tx to its mempool and runs CheckExecute (the VM under the CheckTx mutex) for it although its operator never opted in. No test turns red: baseapp_test.go:653 and :706, sponsorship_bench_test.go:129, sponsorship_load_test.go:73 and sponsorship_usecase_test.go:246 all set it true, and node_testing.go:103 sets it true for every node the txtar `gnoland start` launches through RunNode/TestingMinimalNodeConfig.
candidates.verify_by: grep -rn 'not accepted by this validator\|SetAllowZeroFeeTxs(false)\|AllowZeroFeeTxs: *false' --include='*_test.go' . in the head worktree (0 hits); then mutate baseapp.go:661 to `if false {` and run go test -count=1 -run 'ZeroFee|Sponsored|CheckTx' ./tm2/pkg/sdk/ and go test -count=1 -run 'Sponsorship' ./gno.land/pkg/gnoland/: expect a red test, observe all green
candidates.evidence: grep over *_test.go for the refusal text, SetAllowZeroFeeTxs(false) or AllowZeroFeeTxs false: 0 hits. Only setters found: baseapp_test.go:653 and :706 `bapp.SetAllowZeroFeeTxs(true)`, sponsorship_bench_test.go:129, sponsorship_load_test.go:73, sponsorship_usecase_test.go:246 `opts.AllowZeroFeeTxs = true`, node_testing.go:103 `AllowZeroFeeTxs: true`. The gate's only use is baseapp.go:661, inside CheckTx.

candidates.summary: `gnoland start` opens the credit window (MaxGasCreditPerTx 10M) on every txtar node and offers no flag to close it, so no txtar can run a 0-fee tx on the shipped closed-window config
candidates.failure_scenario: A regression that lets a 0-fee tx execute on a chain that never opted in (MaxGasCreditPerTx 0) passes every txtar, because the harness forces the window open for all of them. Since Tx.ValidateBasic was relaxed, the ante check is the only thing stopping that tx, as the PR's own comment on TestAnteHandlerRejectsZeroFeeWhenCreditWindowDisabled says. That unit test covers the ante on its own; no node-level test covers the gnokey -> CheckTx -> ante path. The window size can also only be changed through -max-gas, which lowers block MaxGas too, so paygas_credit_exhausted.txtar has to burn the full hard-coded 10M.
candidates.verify_by: Read the start flags at testscript_gnoland.go:268-271: non-validator, lock-transfer, no-parallel, max-gas, none for the credit. Run grep -rlE 'gas-fee +0' gno.land/pkg/integration/testdata: every hit is a new paygas_/paystorage_ txtar on the open window, and the base tree has 0 hits. To check the fix, add a `-max-gas-credit` flag (0 closes the window) and a txtar running `gnoland start -max-gas-credit 0` then `gnokey maketx call -gas-fee 0ugnot ...`, expecting stderr 'zero-fee transactions require a non-zero Block.MaxGasCreditPerTx'
candidates.evidence: Head start flags: lines 268-271, fs.Bool non-validator, lock-transfer, no-parallel and fs.Int64 max-gas only. Line 293: `bp.MaxGasCreditPerTx = 10_000_000`, unconditional. `grep -rlE 'gas-fee +0'` gives 0 hits in base testdata and 18 hits in head, all new paygas_/paystorage_ txtars.

candidates.summary: fit_linear floors Base to the N=12 measurement, then the LenString slope charges those 12 bytes again, so every payGas/payStorage call is overcharged by about 415 gas
candidates.failure_scenario: At the shortest realm path, `gno.land/r/a` (12 bytes), the measured cost is 1097 ns but the row charges 1097 + 35448*12/1024 = 1512 gas, 38% over. A typical 19-byte path is charged 1755 against about 1339 measured. The rows ship as consensus gas, so fixing them later is itself a gas change.
candidates.verify_by: python3 gen_native_table.py sponsorship_bench_m1pro_arm64.txt --no-plot --md-out /dev/null --go-out /dev/null prints Base 1097 = ns at N=12 (fit_linear: base = max(coeffs[0], ns[0])); nativeSizeOf at gnovm/pkg/gnolang/native_gas.go:357 charges the full tv.GetLength(). Fix: floor to ns[0] - slope*sizes[0]
candidates.evidence: The generator rerun printed `{Pkg: "chain/runtime", Fn: "payGas", Base: 1097, Slope: 35448, SlopeIdx: 0, SlopeKind: SizeLenString}`, the same row as native_gas.go:169. The bench data has PayGas_12 at 1097 ns/op. In native_gas.go, nativeSizeOf's default case returns int64(tv.GetLength()).
